review_evidence: README identifies a Lean 4 formalization of the Hadwiger-Nelson lower bound, verifying that a 510-vertex unit-distance graph is not 4-colorable.

The source modules parse graph vertices, construct and certify unit-distance edges, reduce colorability to CNF unsatisfiability, and connect the finite graph result to plane coloring; these are all parts of the formal proof pipeline.
The Lean lakefile records dependencies but is itself formal-language build DSL, and the remaining modules are direct proof components; no content-level lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Hadwiger-Nelson Lean formalization and proof pipeline; no safe hard exclusion was found.
